title: Consultant | GenAI Engineer | Analytics & Engineering
description: Who we are ADC is a European data and AI consultancy with offices in the Netherlands, Sweden, and Denmark. You’ll be part of a true collective, working alongside AI and Data Engineers, to deliver impact-driven solutions.
